hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -q 'src/Root.tsx' && npm run sync:viewer >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'viewer registry synced' || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */src/projects/*.tsx|*/src/projects/*.ts) out=$(LINT_REMOTION_QUIET=1 node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/lint-remotion.mjs" "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
input=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$input" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|] *)git commit'; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/commit-gate.sh" || exit 2; fi; exit 0

input=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$input" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|] *)npm (start|run start)\b|remotion studio'; then echo 'BLOCKED: never default Remotion Studio — use `npm run viewer` (port 4000)' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
